Fantik Studio — Award-winning Branding, Web & Motion Design Studio

Fantik Studio is a full-cycle creative studio founded in 2024 in Kyiv, Ukraine, working worldwide. We craft brand identities, immersive 3D and interactive websites, and motion design for startups, SaaS, B2B companies, AI/ML products and Web3 projects. The studio has been recognized with 3 Sites of the Day (CSSDesignAwards ×2, CSS Winner ×1), 2 Awwwards Honorable Mentions, and was featured in the Dribbble Select 2026 editorial “Most Impactful Agency Projects of 2026.”

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Fantik Studio?

Fantik Studio is a branding, web and motion design studio that builds award-winning interactive and 3D websites. The studio works with startups, SaaS, B2B, AI/ML and Web3 clients worldwide.

What services does Fantik Studio offer?

Brand identity, web design, front-end and full-stack development, interactive WebGL and GLSL experiences, 3D design, motion design, Webflow and Framer development, and brand strategy.

Where is Fantik Studio based?

Fantik Studio is headquartered in Kyiv, Ukraine and works with clients worldwide remotely.

What awards has Fantik Studio received?

Fantik Studio has won 3 Sites of the Day (CSSDesignAwards ×2, CSS Winner), 2 Awwwards Honorable Mentions, nominations at Orpetron and WDAwards, and features in Muzli and GSAP showcases. In 2026 Fantik Studio was selected for the Dribbble Select editorial “Most Impactful Agency Projects of 2026” for the studio’s creative influence.

What technologies does Fantik Studio use?

Three.js, WebGL, GLSL shaders, GSAP, React, Next.js, Vue, Webflow, Framer, Lottie, Cinema 4D, Blender and After Effects.

How much does a Fantik Studio project cost?

Fantik Studio works on a fixed-price model. Landing pages start at $1,500, corporate websites at $4,500, Webflow or Framer builds at $800, interactive WebGL or 3D projects at $8,000, motion design at $600, brand identity at $1,500, and ongoing retainers at $800/month.

Who is Fantik Studio for?

Startups, SaaS companies, B2B businesses, AI and ML products, and Web3 projects that need a distinctive brand and a memorable interactive website.

How can I contact Fantik Studio?

Email hello@fantik.studio or book a 15-minute intro call at calendly.com/fantik-studio/15min.
